questions.stem: A 16-year-old female with cystic fibrosis presents with increased productive cough, fever, and worsening shortness of breath. Her sputum culture grows Pseudomonas aeruginosa. Which of the following best explains why this organism commonly causes respiratory infections in cystic fibrosis patients?

options.label: A
options.text: Defective neutrophil chemotaxis to the site of infection

options.label: B
options.text: Abnormal periciliary fluid layer leading to impaired mucociliary clearance

options.label: C
options.text: Direct immunosuppressive effect of the CFTR protein mutation

options.label: D
options.text: Increased expression of bacterial adhesion molecules on respiratory epithelium
